title: Clawd X Digest
summary: President Trump Announces Permanent Greenland Security Agreement & White House Media Bans: The U.S. enters an 'Infinite Life' defense agreement with Denmark and Greenland granting permanent U.S. security rights, alongside immediate press access bans on CNN, MSNOW, and Politico.

WebMCP + Jev Benchmarks Solve 100% of Web Tasks at 112x Lower Cost: New benchmarks demonstrate that pairing Jev for action selection with Mercury 2.5 for argument generation via WebMCP solves 100% of web agent tasks at 112x lower cost than visual computer-use models.

Cua Open-Sources Cua-S1-FORMS 2.8MB System-1 Model for Computer Use: Cua releases a 706K-parameter open-weights System-1 model scoring 99.7% on form-filling evaluations, replacing heavy LLM calls for routine web browser actions.
Elon Musk Projects AI to Double U.S. GDP Growth to ~4% Next Year: Musk forecasts that rapid enterprise AI adoption will double U.S. annual GDP growth from ~2% to ~4%+ starting in 2027.

Bayern Munich Demolishes Union Berlin 7-0 as Harry Kane & Michael Olise Break Records: Harry Kane becomes the fastest player to reach 100 Bundesliga goals (101 total), while Michael Olise scores a hat-trick and assist to reach 11 G/A in 7 matches.

items.title: @0xidanlevin: WebMCP + Jev Solves 100% of Web Agent Tasks at 112x Lower Model Cost
items.body: Benchmarks show pairing Jev for tool selection with Mercury for argument generation via WebMCP solves 100% of browser tasks at 112x lower cost than vision-based computer use models.

items.title: @trycua: Cua Open-Sources Cua-S1-FORMS 2.8MB System-1 Model for Computer Use
items.body: Cua releases Cua-S1-FORMS, a 706K-parameter / 2.8MB specialized System-1 model built for form-filling and browser actions, achieving 99.7% evaluation accuracy.

items.title: @RohanNayak2: Pocket FM Launches Sherpa Fiction AI Trained on 5.5B Hours of Playtime Data
items.body: Pocket FM introduces Sherpa, a specialized fiction writing AI that uses semantic knowledge graphs and dynamic replanning to generate serialized audio dramas, boosting ARR to $500M.

items.title: @googlegemma: Google Gemma Team Previews DiffusionGemma-as-Jev for Non-Autoregressive Decisions
items.body: Google Gemma showcases canvas diffusion to evaluate structured decision spaces concurrently in a single parallel step (~0.2s on DGX hardware).

items.title: @AnthropicAI: Anthropic & Accenture Partner on $1B Frontier AI Independent Evals
items.body: Anthropic and Accenture commit over $1 Billion over five years to build independent evaluation capacity for frontier AI models.

items.title: @peteryared: AgentCloak Launches In-Browser Sensitive Data Anonymizer for AI Tools
items.body: AgentCloak releases a free browser extension that automatically replaces PII and sensitive context with realistic fakes before sending queries to ChatGPT or Claude.

items.title: @ctatedev: Instant Generative UI Developed with json-render and Jev
items.body: Developers demonstrate instant generative UI components rendered in milliseconds by pairing json-render design systems with Jev fast decision logic.

items.title: @realDonaldTrump: President Trump Announces Permanent Greenland Security Agreement
items.body: The U.S. enters an 'Infinite Life' agreement with Denmark and Greenland for U.S. military base construction and permanent security rights at no cost to the U.S.

items.title: @realDonaldTrump: White House Bans CNN, MSNOW, and Politico Over Reporting Practices
items.body: President Trump announces an immediate ban of CNN, MSNOW, and Politico from White House access, citing media integrity and government subscription grants under prior administration.

items.title: @elonmusk: Elon Musk Forecasts AI Will Double U.S. GDP Growth to 4% Next Year
items.body: Musk estimates that AI productivity gains will roughly double U.S. annual GDP growth from ~2% to ~4% or higher starting next year.

items.title: @ethanl_0x: Comprehensive Analysis of Zhu Xiaohu's AI Commercialization Playbook
items.body: A 19-point breakdown of GSR Ventures partner Zhu Xiaohu's key insights on AI moats, retention standards (50%+ M2), and shifting from token maxing to value maxing.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Bayern Munich Thrashes Union Berlin 7-0 as Kane Reaches 100 Goals & Olise Scores Hat-Trick
items.body: Harry Kane becomes the fastest player in Bundesliga history to hit 100 goals, while Michael Olise notches a hat-trick and assist (11 G/A in 7 games).

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Lamine Yamal Speaks Out on Ballon d'Or & Champions League Matchups
items.body: Barcelona star Lamine Yamal discusses how off-ball movement draws defenders and prepares for upcoming European clashes against Bayern and PSG.

items.title: @METALSLUG_EN: SNK Announces Metal Slug Ultimate Collection for 2027
items.body: SNK reveals Metal Slug Ultimate Collection containing 9 classic titles plus the legendary unreleased location test version for Metal Slug's 30th Anniversary.
